decisions: The filed symptom was stale: win32sigs (DIV-141) already fixed the argument-EATING half. The live defect was the mirror image, the staged pushes being DROPPED.

Root cause differs from the need's reference note: FuncProto::resolve_extra_pop is a ported function nothing in the tree ever called, so a locked import prototype still reached StackSolver as extrapop-unknown and calleepop guessed the cleanup off the caller's push run.

Second half needed for the acceptance's address-of clause: Heritage::guardCalls plants an INDIRECT over the caller's stack at every call, which stops a staged value reaching the call it was staged for.

A plain 'the callee does not touch the caller's stack' rule is UNSOUND -- it would break ReadFile(h,&buf,...). Gated on AliasChecker::has_local_alias, the same test checkInputTrialUse already applies.

Dropped a third half (delivering the parked prototype at ActionDeindirect) after measuring that it moved two existing tests/cli expectations; the vendored fixture was instead made to end in a no-return import, which is what the reported image does and what triggers the restart that delivers the signature.
No tests/stages case: the datatest harness cannot 'load file' a synthesized PE (the pre-existing win32sigs_pe_i386.exe fails there too). Measured blind spot, recorded not worked around.
